name: showtape
description: Network-only web application for turning one setlist.fm setlist into an Apple Music playlist.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter @repo/shared run build && corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter @repo/core run build && corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter @repo/api run build && corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter web exec playwright test --config=../../playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:screenshots: corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter web exec playwright test --config=../../playwright.config.ts --grep @screenshots
scripts.test:e2e:performance: PLAYWRIGHT_PRODUCTION=1 corepack pnpm@9.15.3 --filter web exec playwright test --config=../../playwright.config.ts --grep @performance
